caption: Third onboarding screen: Finish refused the made up email address we typed with Please enter a reachable email address; the address, the chat avatar and the store name are hidden.
Store data sync finished within about 20 seconds of the onboarding, under a banner for 30% off the first 3 months and a trial that ends 30 Nov; the chat avatar and the store name are hidden.
Typo test: snowbord in the search overlay returned five snowboards with price and stock, plus the suggestions snowboard and collection snowboard, in about 2 seconds.
View all opened a results page the app built itself: 13 results for snowbord, Category and Product Type filters and a price slider from $10 to $2630; the store name in the header is hidden.
Free plan at the 2K sessions position: up to 1.000 products and Branded search; the chat avatar and the store name are hidden.
At 5K sessions the plan is $10 a month for the first 3 months, then $14, and the search becomes Unbranded; the chat avatar and the store name are hidden.
Shopify approval for Basic 1 Plan: $10,00 due 30 Nov after a 14-day free trial, with $4,00 off for 3 charges. Approve stayed greyed out and nothing was paid; the store name is hidden.
